provider.connectionModes: API key only: apiKey (or accessToken when the key is stored there), sent raw as x-api-key; connection proxy settings honored; connection base URLs ignored

models.name: Wan 2.7 Image-to-Video
models.status: refused before submit: needs an input image the source body never sends; not in SEGMIND_VIDEO_MODELS

acceptedModelIds: a starter slug, `segmind/<slug>`, or any other single Segmind slug matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ (case-insensitive, no ..); slugs naming image-to-video (i2v, image-to-video, img2vid) are refused
dynamicModels: none discovered: the source documents routing any Segmind slug as the model id and calls no model-listing API

endpoints.generate: POST https://api.segmind.com/v1/{slug} (Content-Type: application/json; redirect manual and refused; an answer from another origin is discarded with acceptedJob)
endpoints.response: raw MP4 bytes (ftyp box), at most 64 MiB, within the 600 s deadline shared with the request
endpoints.cancel: none (Segmind has no job id; an abort only stops this client)

exports.adapter: default export of adapter.js (also segmindVideoAdapter from index.js): { async: true, responseFormats: ["b64_json"], defaultResponseFormat: "b64_json", generate({ model, body, credentials, signal, log }) }
